_note: Public repository: GitHub minutes are unlimited, so held shares are watched live all day for the stop and there is no minutes limit. For a private repository (2,000 free minutes a month) set watch_holding_days to false and monthly_minute_budget to 1650.
_note_buy_hours: whole_day = 5 slices 9:30 am - 2:00 pm (as tested for 5 years); morning = 5 slices 9:30 - 11:30 am, about half the GitHub minutes per buy day.
